Items / Items

Notable Items

Things the party owns, has encountered, or should probably be able to identify if someone points one at them.

Bracers of Archery — Stripes Bitemore’s. Leather bracers granting proficiency with longbow and shortbow and a +2 bonus to damage with both.

Clyde’s Bestiary of Oceanic Creatures — A naturalist’s survey of oceanic creatures, written with the kind of contempt for the reader that only comes from genuine expertise. Useful for identifying things that might eat a ship.

Eldritch Claw Tattoo — Crissdalynn’s, given by Master Kyzil the day she received her pilgrimage task. Makes unarmed strikes magical; once per dawn the lines extend fifteen feet, add force damage, then snap back. A Sentinel tradition older than anyone has tried to trace.

Pearl of Souls — A divine object with ties to Umberlee, Fisk’s lost fleet, and whatever is at the bottom of the Maw. Nobody who’s held it seems entirely comfortable talking about it afterward.

The Baroness — Delmar Fisk’s rapier. Well-traveled.

The Duchess — Delmar Fisk’s musket. Same.

Mira’s Blade — A +1 shortsword with a distinctive notched pommel. Found in a confiscation crate aboard the HCS Surety. The matching pendant in the same crate reads “For Mira, from the sea.” Who Mira is, and who Rook took these from, is unresolved.

Potion of Water Breathing — For one hour, breathe underwater as easily as air. Standard emergency kit on serious sea vessels. Harder to source at most Midchain free ports.

Truth Stone — A smooth grey stone that heats white-hot when held by someone who knowingly lies. Common on the Midchain. Favored by captains who’ve been burned by a false manifest. Beaumont Sel carries one.

Phrase Box — A clockwork brass-and-wood case with rows of labeled buttons that emit tones for common maritime words and phrases. The standard communication aid for Kenku working ships. 8 gp, no attunement, Maritime Standard layout.

Available Equipment

Pneumatic Grapple — Wrist-mounted grapple that fires 60 feet and retracts mechanically. Three shots before a 10-minute repressurize. Available from Catarina Da’Virelli by referral.

Lantern of Revealing — Illuminates invisible creatures and objects within range.

Weapon Reference

Melee Weapons

Rapier — Martial melee weapon. 1d8 piercing, Finesse. The go-to for Dexterity fighters who want a d8 damage die without committing to Strength.

Bows

Shortbow — Simple ranged weapon. 1d6 piercing, range 80/320, Ammunition, Two-Handed. No martial proficiency required.

Longbow — Martial ranged weapon. 1d8 piercing, range 150/600, Ammunition, Heavy, Two-Handed. Best range of any standard bow; Heavy shuts out Small creatures.

Crossbows

Hand Crossbow — Martial ranged weapon. 1d6 piercing, range 30/120, Ammunition, Light, Loading. Only ranged weapon usable alongside a melee weapon; Loading caps it at one shot per action without Crossbow Expert.

Heavy Crossbow — Martial ranged weapon. 1d10 piercing, range 100/400, Ammunition, Heavy, Loading, Two-Handed. Highest crossbow damage; Loading and Heavy are both costs.

Firearms (Homebrew)

Flintlock Pistol — Martial ranged weapon. 1d10 piercing, range 30/90, Loading, Light. Heavy crossbow damage in a one-handed package. Loud; misfires on a 1; powder must stay dry.

Musket — Martial ranged weapon. 1d12 piercing, range 40/120, Loading, Two-Handed. Highest single-shot damage of any ranged weapon. Loud; misfires on a 1; higher wet-weather risk than the pistol.
